name: Agedashi Tofu
steps: Soak kombu and shiitake in water for 20 minutes. Warm gently, remove kombu before boiling, simmer mushrooms 5 minutes and strain.
Press tofu in towels for 15 minutes, then cut into blocks. Grate radish and ginger separately; squeeze radish dry.
Coat dry tofu with starch. Shallow-fry in hot oil for 3 minutes per side until pale golden; drain on a rack.
Warm strained broth with soy sauce and sugar. Pour around tofu in bowls; top with radish, ginger and spring onions.
tips: Pour broth only just before eating to retain the delicate crust.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
